# FLX-3109: the profile the Simulation pins and the profile supplied do not pair

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A Simulation that pins a profile under extensions['com.agentics.flux/1'].profile needs that profile handed to plan with --profile, and a run planned from it needs it handed to ship, and to verify for its scorecard; a profile handed to a Simulation or a run that pins none would be read by nothing. The message says which side is missing. Pass the profile file, or pin its digest in the Simulation, or drop the one that is not wanted. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3109
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
